programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger dig beneath the postcard-perfect landscapes of Colorado to uncover a narrative of sacred homelands, the untold legacy of Black cowboys, and the rugged survival of mountain pioneers. The journey begins at the confluence of the South Platte River and Cherry Creek—the sacred heart of downtown Denver—where Rick Williams of People of Sacred Land reveals the 11,000-year history of the Cheyenne, Arapaho, and Ute nations. Facing the 'hard truths' of history, Mayor Mike Johnston discusses the city's commitment to recognition, including the creation of the first American Indian cultural embassy. The exploration continues at the Black American West Museum, where the hosts rediscover the 'lost brand' of the frontier: the Black cowboys and Exodusters who made up one in three cattle drivers in the Old West. Transitioning from the plains to the peaks, the team heads to Telluride and Winter Park to experience the evolution of mountain life. From the 19th-century 'Norwegian snowshoes' used by miners to high-speed snowmobile treks through the Silverton Caldera, the episode captures the adrenaline of the Rockies' gold-mining past. The journey concludes with a taste of the land, from traditional chokecherry puddings to a six-course Creole menu at The Tunnel—a modern speakeasy that honors the secret history of Prohibition-era Colorado.

programme.title: WORLD OF TRAVEL [P13]
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger explore the transformation of Denver, Colorado, from a frontier legend to a modern cultural pioneer, discovering how old western grit meets new ambition in the place they call home. The journey begins in the shadow of the Rockies, where the hosts explore the 'Queen City of the Plains' and its history of constant reinvention. Guided by civic leaders including Mayor Mike Johnston, the episode explores Denver’s progressive legacy—from its early adoption of women's suffrage to its rise as a national innovation hub. The narrative also examines the city's modern 'green rush,' detailing how the 2014 legalization of marijuana transformed the state's economy, generating over $1.2 billion in tax revenue and creating a new frontier for medical and recreational tourism. The hosts pay homage to the area's first inhabitants, acknowledging that the land Denver sits on originally belonged to the Arapaho, Cheyenne, and Ute peoples. This cultural thread leads to the iconic Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre, a geological wonder formed 300 million years ago and designated a National Historic Landmark. By tracing the city's history from ancient indigenous winter camping sites to world-renowned concert stages, the journey proves that the modern West is wiser, more inclusive, and still full of adventure.

programme.title: ARCHAEOLOGY [P13]
programme.desc: Twenty-five years ago, the ancient Mayans were thought to be a mysterious and peaceful people governed by astronomer-priests. But in 1965, Russian linguist Yuri Knorosov cracked the phonetic code of Mayan hieroglyphic writing in the confinements of his bustling Leningrad study. Today, researchers reveal stories of Mayan blood sacrifices as they uncover a world so foreign as to defy our understanding of it. From excavations deep in the jungles of Honduras to the most recent interpretations of hieroglyphic messages, researchers are unraveling the fascinating story of the rise and fall of the Mayans.

programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger dig beneath the postcard-perfect landscapes of Colorado to uncover a narrative of sacred homelands, the untold legacy of Black cowboys, and the rugged survival of mountain pioneers. The journey begins at the confluence of the South Platte River and Cherry Creek—the sacred heart of downtown Denver—where Rick Williams of People of Sacred Land reveals the 11,000-year history of the Cheyenne, Arapaho, and Ute nations. Facing the 'hard truths' of history, Mayor Mike Johnston discusses the city's commitment to recognition, including the creation of the first American Indian cultural embassy. The exploration continues at the Black American West Museum, where the hosts rediscover the 'lost brand' of the frontier: the Black cowboys and Exodusters who made up one in three cattle drivers in the Old West. Transitioning from the plains to the peaks, the team heads to Telluride and Winter Park to experience the evolution of mountain life. From the 19th-century 'Norwegian snowshoes' used by miners to high-speed snowmobile treks through the Silverton Caldera, the episode captures the adrenaline of the Rockies' gold-mining past. The journey concludes with a taste of the land, from traditional chokecherry puddings to a six-course Creole menu at The Tunnel—a modern speakeasy that honors the secret history of Prohibition-era Colorado.

programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 98 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Jammbo’s in trouble! Its amazing music bubbles are full of trash and gunky goo. After a planet wide investigation, the King, Queen and kids realize that the junk in the bubbles is their own garbage! They work together to change their sloppy habits and restore Jammbo’s jelly-good health. In the process they recycle their garbage into something they can all enjoy.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Thanks to some breakthrough science, Mina is able to make objects, and herself, invisible! She can’t help but see the effects of invisibility on her unsuspecting friends! After a day of wild happenings the kids discover the culprit of all the invisible weirdness. They come up with an experiment of their own to see how much the scientist likes being tested!

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: One of the most amazing events that Jammbo has ever experienced is about to occur. And Goomo doesn’t want tomiss it. That’s why he tries to hide his Jelly-Measles from his friends. Unfortunately, the measles have symptoms that are impossible to disguise.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Spooked by lighting and thunder, Bello and Goomo seek refuge in the Music Factory. But once inside, they realize there’s much scarier stuff afoot; there’s a ghost in the castle that’s frightening the dodos and keeping them from making music bubbles! And if the dodos stop, Jammbo has no music. If there’s no music, the planet freezes! Yikes! It’s up to the boys to find the ghost, put an end to the spookiness and save the ever-musical Jammbo!

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: The King doesn’t want to share his new rocket powered skateboard so he hides it in a magic box. Goomo and Bello decide to claim it, challenging the King’s wishes, and end up in a new and larger world. A world of fun and….danger.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: The Queen feels gloomy. The King and the children agree to organize the best birthday party ever. Unfortunately each of the participants has a very particular idea as to how to organize the Queen’s surprise party. Its success will depend on their capacity to put themselves “in each others’ shoes”…especially the Queen’s.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Bello is fed up with the Queen, whom he thinks tries to ruin all his adventures and games. On a starry night, full of shooting stars, Bello makes a wish: may the Queen become a young girl again so she can let him do anything he wants. When Bello’s wish comes true, he will have to act like the crazy little Queen’s older brother and realizes the task can be hard, difficult and at times, even dangerous.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: It's Goomo's birthday and his hopes are high. Unfortunately, he wakes to find his precious helmet missing! On top of that his friends are acting strangely and they all appear to have forgotten all about his birthday. Goomo would be happy to have things simply return to normal. Luckily, he’s in for a surprise that could make this day a very special one indeed.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Ongo hurt himself while playing with Bello and Goomo so he must stay at home to rest for several days. Bello feels guilty and decides to move into Ongo’s house until his friend feels better. Their different views on life will meet and together they’ll discover that everything, even the smallest detail, can be enjoyed if seen with open eyes.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Rita tries her own experiments in Mina’s lab. She’ll soon discover she first needs to learn some basics in order to avoid a disaster.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Goomo has lost the glasses he uses to play Jammboman and Helmetkid with Bello. Both friends discover a blind Dodo wearing Goomo’s glasses. With them on, the Dodo can actually see and play with the rest of the Dodos. Will Goomo give up his glasses or take them back to be a superhero?

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Rita and Princess are having a lovely pink picnic: pink dishes, pink food, pink everything! Rita confides in Princess how she would like everything on Jammbo to be her favorite color. She rushes to the Music Factory and switches the multi-colored music bubbles to pink which threatens to make everything look and sound the same! When the other kids realize what Rita has set in motion they must work furiously to restore the natural diversity of Jammbo before it becomes a big, boring, barren pink wasteland!

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Goomo and Rita enjoy their day in the outdoors when they suddenly discover a Dodo egg. The children and the small egg will go on an action-packed adventure. Will the egg survive after so much hustle and bustle?

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: The Disk of Sounds has gone crazy and all the sounds in Jammbo have been changed, causing a huge chaos. Bello and Rita willbe in charge of returning each sound to the place where it belongs.

programme.title: Jelly Jamm [U]
programme.desc: Bello has to wear an eye patch. He feels uncomfortable and discouraged because of how he looks. Luckily, his friends use the wisdom of a song to remind him that any problem can turn into something fun.

programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Xiwu terserempak dengan Pian Ran dalam perjalanan untuk pulang ke tanah airnya. Dengan bimbingan Pian Ran, dia menuju ke sebuah jurang fantasi menghalangnya daripada berubah menjadi raja iblis.

programme.title: TREASURE HUNT IN MALAYSIA 3
programme.desc: Episod ini dua orang hos bersama dua orang tetamu jemputan yang merupakan hos TV dibahagikan kepada dua kumpulan untuk mengambil bahagian dalam siri permainan di Eagle Ranch Resort, Port Dickson.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kimura Kenji membawa Shengyuan, Ziting dan Zixian ke bilik hotel untuk bertemu dengan Wenxue. Kimura Kenji menunjukkan klip video tentang Jialiang dan Wenxue datang ke hotel itu. Dia juga mendakwa Wenxue hamil dan siapa ayahnya.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: San Hao dan Thong menolak cadangan Vincent untuk membeli saham dalam Hao Jie Logistics. Vincent kemudian bercadang untuk membeli satu produk milik San Hao yang berkaitan dengan Yitonggao dan dipersetujui.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Ruguan gembira dia dapat menghalang Shu Shu daripada menggoda Huan Qi. Jia Ming marah apabila ternampak Chee Kan dan Ruo Lan bersama di dalam bilik hospital untuk menjaga Toto.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Yi Loong dan Jin Hu adalah kawan rapat dan kedua-duanya miskin. Yi Loong seorang yang jujur, baik hati dan mempunyai sifat yang adil manakala Jin Hu seorang oportunis. Mereka berdua selalu ditipu oleh majikan mereka.

programme.title: MY ONE AND ONLY
programme.desc: Renpin enggan menerima keputusan Jingjing, manakala Haojian dan Huiling bergilir-gilir menjaga Limin yang demam. Sementara itu, Zhongyi mendapati May memalsukan kecederaannya, dan Yurou meminta bantuan Haojian akibat diganggu.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Cheng Shi, ketua keluarga Cheng, dan isterinya Xiao Yuan Yi yang bertahun-tahun di medan perang dalam perjalanan pulang membawa kejayaan tapi anak perempuan tunggal mereka, Cheng Shao Shang kini dalam situasi membimbangkan.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Apabila pulang ke rumah, penampilan Shao Shang tidak dipandang serius terutama oleh neneknya yang sentiasa bersaing dengannya untuk mendapat perhatian anaknya, Cheng Shi. Shao Shang tidak mahu dia diabaikan seperti ibunya.

programme.title: LOVE VIRTUALLY
programme.desc: Cheng Cheng dikurung oleh Dan dan Natasha selepas dipaksa menyerahkan teknologi pemindahan segera demi mencuri dana kebajikan. Dengan bantuan Adam, Cheng Cheng berjaya melepaskan diri dan merancang helah untuk melaga-lagakan pasangan itu.

programme.title: CAHAYA KAMPUNG BARU
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan pengembaraan ke Kampung Baru Manchis untuk bertemu pengasas Kumpulan LKE yang memiliki ladang eko-pelancongan durian premium. Terokai keunikan LKE Space, inap desa, serta program anak angkat pokok durian.

programme.title: YES! NIGHT MARKET
programme.desc: Episod ini tiga orang hos dibantu dua selebriti jemputan akan menjual bebola ubi dan "cong you bing" di sebuah taman permainan di Jepun untuk diberikan kepada pengunjung bagi mendapat maklum balas mengenai rasa dan harga jualan.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Ah Sheng merayu ibunya Cai Yan untuk membantunya memikat hati Suk Fen semula. Megan tidak dapat tidur lena pada waktu malam kerana diganggu oleh Cai Ruan. Hao Nan mencadangkan agar dia berpindah ke biliknya.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Ke Lun dan Jia Cai yang terserempak di sebuah taman tema, melakukan CPR untuk seorang lelaki yang pengsan secara tiba-tiba. Ren Hui yang melawat Cai Ruan di rumah, terpaksa tenangkan Megan yang tertekan semasa menjaga Cai Ruan.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kimura Kenji memberitahu Jialiang bahawa Wenxue tak akan terlibat dalam pengurusan Omar Shopping Mall. Yufei dan Kuro terserempak dengan Yunyun dan kemudian membawa Yunyun ke balai polis. Pihak polis terpaksa membebaskan Yunyun.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Kuang Zhong mengupah samseng untuk membalas dendam terhadap Ah Keong. San Hao, Thong dan Kuro tiba untuk membantu Ah Keong. Vincent dan Kuang Zhong tiba untuk menjadi orang tengah tetapi gagal sehingga berlaku pergaduhan.

programme.title: GREAT TIMES
programme.desc: Berita tentang kilang Chuen Kuo Heng Tai di Vietnam dihentikan pengeluaran menyebabkan harga saham jatuh teruk. Kedua-dua Jia Mei dan Ho sebaliknya membeli saham daripada bursa. Jabatan pendakwaan cuba menangkap 'insider trading'

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Liu, lelaki terkaya di kampung dan anak perempuannya Mei Yao tahu tentang kekayaan Yi Loong cuba menipunya. Jin Hu jatuh hati pada Mei Yao. Qin Fat dan Shan Shuo adalah perompak juga cuba mendapatkan kekayaan daripada Yi Loong.

programme.title: KEEP RUNNING: YELLOW RIVER 2
programme.desc: Episod ini seramai 7 ahli rombongan "Keep Running" dan artis jemputan Victor Qin dan Gong Lijiao berada di Lanzhou, Wilayah Gansu, China dibahagikan kepada dua pasukan untuk bersaing dalam siri permainan bertema "Sukan".

programme.title: THE GREATEST OF US REUNION EDITION
programme.desc: Menampilkan lapan penyanyi terkenal tempatan berhimpun bersama di Pavillion Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur, untuk mempersembahkan sebuah konsert yang menampilkan pelbagai genre lagu untuk hiburan semua.

programme.title: PROJECT LOVE SEASON 3
programme.desc: 8TV’s heartfelt programme Project Love Season 3 returns with warmth and purpose!Continuing the mission of the first 2 seasons touching hearts through real stories,Project Love Season 3 steps even closer into the everyday lives of ordinary Malaysians.

programme.title: LOVE VIRTUALLY
programme.desc: Neo mengelak isu tunggakan bank, manakala usaha Xiao Yu membantunya menemui jalan buntu. Xiao Yu sebenarnya curang dengan Neo tanpa pengetahuan Ming. Dalam keadaan terdesak, Neo bertindak memadamkan program penting 4+1.

programme.title: THE TREASURED VOICE S6
programme.desc: Menampilkan 12 penyanyi akan membuat persembahan nyanyian lagu klasik secara berduet. Persembahan mereka akan dinilai oleh 5 orang panel ahli muzik dan pemenang setiap pusingan akan berpeluang merebut Anugerah Lagu Emas Tahunan.

programme.title: WEAVING A TALE OF LOVE S2
programme.desc: Shu Naji yang merupakan ketua tentera di Wilayah Liang menerima arahan daripada Puteri Linhai untuk menangkap Liu Li apabila dia memasuki wilayahnya. Entah bagaimana Liu Li bertukar identiti ditangkap dan dimasukkan ke dalam penjara.

programme.title: WEAVING A TALE OF LOVE S2
programme.desc: Melalui Xingjian, Liu Li dibebaskan. Pei Xingjian memberitahu rahsia istana kepada Shu Naji yang kemudian menulis surat kepada tuannya di istana. Xingjian sengaja pergunakan Shu bagi memecahbelahkan pegawai tertinggi istana.

programme.title: SURI HATI
programme.desc: Sarah dan anaknya Zahra tinggal di rumah kakaknya Adilah selepas diceraikan. Ahlong mengugut Khader, sekiranya Khader tidak membayar hutang mereka, isteri dan anaknya akan menjadi mangsa mereka.

programme.title: RISIK PADA HATI
programme.desc: Hayfa bercerita kepada suaminya mengenai perkenalan singkatnya dengan Asiyah. Adam menerima mesej dari Atilia minta datang ke rumah sewanya kononnya paip rumah mereka rosak. Adam pun pergi bersama isterinya.

programme.title: DESTINASI KERJAYA 24/25

programme.title: SAYA ISTIMEWA

programme.title: BEST IN TOWN SEASON 1

programme.title: JALAN-JALAN MAKAN ANGIN 2019

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklace's dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

programme.title: 7ujuh
programme.desc: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. programme.title: Creepy Pasta
programme.desc: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. programme.desc: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.
